checks.name: Recovery controller boots with the native game loop
Actual loss event pauses drawing and simulation
Direct render while lost cannot build sectors or mutate the retired generation
Inputs cannot fire or enter cars behind the recovery dialog
Held Gauss charge was cancelled without spending ammo
Keyboard focus remains inside recovery dialog
Live JSON export is usable while graphics are lost
Existing catalogue was not overwritten by loss or export
Restore rebuilds resources, skin maps and the Mercado atlas
A stale renderer stays inert after the context has been restored
New generation still renders a real frame after rejecting a stale draw
Same simulation and active identity survived restoration
No simulation resumes until explicit acknowledgement
One native frame chain resumes without reactivating trigger
Repeated scheduling cannot add a second app RAF
Repeated loss disposes the previous generation without live GPU handles
Translucent equipment selector is restored with pending choice intact
Recovery controls remain visible at phone width
Unsaved appearance draft can also be exported
Creator identity and unsaved draft survive actual context replacement
Cancelling recovered draft leaves session identity unchanged
Failed reconstruction stays blocked and offers export
An explicit retry recovers after a controlled failure
No shader or JavaScript errors in completed recovery paths
No external runtime requests

environment: Chromium SwiftShader, real context events and native RAF. Prepared state, explicit in-memory storage fixture. Not physical GPU performance.
